load_scope: Three signed-RPC workers with 0.75-second pauses plus one real HTTP health worker with one-second pauses. Actual public Chat/Search qualification and a separate private metrics/calendar canary also used the shared core during this interval; those requests are not merged into START/END.
scope_limits: Recorded 45-minute source/PID/load interval; not continuous GPU saturation, a GPU decode benchmark, indefinite memory convergence, or a Windows deployment. The later Cantor resource-publication/API metrics rollout requires a separate interval.

production_observation.limits: No call errors or restarts do not certify bounded memory. Subsequent source/PID changes are a separate interval.
